notes.title: Oktoberfest-Update
notes.notes:
Small Update with some Bugfixes and the Oktoberfestmeleon: 

- Get your Oktoberfest-Meleon 2023 Edition! (Just for a short time)
- Darkmode is back!
- small improvements in the Code
- switch off the visibility of Boxes and Tags ingame
- some Meleons will not drop anymore from now on

notes.title: Small Update Septembre 2023
notes.notes:
What is new?
- A new Meleon for your collection
- Bug fixes (Honeymeleon and Goldenmeleon dont do moonwalks anymore, some improvements on the basecode)
- Some added player made pictures
- A feature to toggle the spawning of useless Meleons (Thanks for the idea, DimkaKMS)

notes.title: NEW UPDATE • NEW CONTENT • NEW STEAM ITEMS
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/35777720aa5b624b2a7df5c5b5aee238e2611b9b.png

We are happy to announce Wall Paint Update!

It was a long break but we are back again with some new content!
If you scroll to the left (Using A/D on keyboard), you will see the Painter-Meleon, who will be very happy to trade with you! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/e356df96d6d280a5153f2c236ee51b41994fdb6a.png
From now on, you can trade your 100 common paint for a Paint Roller! There are 16 Paint Rollers added! (So 16 new Steam Items)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/ef17a297e4d4994942bcc0bfa6f32f49dafc442f.png

If you have 100 common paint (or more), just simply click on one of these buttons.
For example: if you have 100 red common paint, click on the button with red can.
It will REMOVE your 100 red common paint and give you the red paint roller instead!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/0480c7504a2d576423410f98da89702a56a84dc1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/74bcf80b1f0e55d269b4e1e41625e92b356c9a45.png
If you want to change your Wall Color, just click on the Paint Roller.

There is also Maid-Meleon that will help you clean up the studio!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/6d1833a98db7c69750ac1a71678a2fcee21892d6.png

There is -45% Sale on Colormeleons!
It will last until September 30
